name: Beached Sea Creature
summary: At Mist's Edge, a giant sea thresher lies stranded while murlocs feed on its carcass. In Auberdine, Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde gathers samples for night elf researchers in Darnassus, who seek to learn why deep-sea giants are washing ashore.

sections.title: A Giant on the Shallows
sections.body: Enormous thresher remains have appeared along Mist's Edge, where shipwrecks and tide-washed debris are familiar sights. This beast dwarfs the wildlife of Darkshore's shallows, suggesting it came from far beyond the calm waters of the Veiled Sea. Murlocs swarm over the corpse to feed, but they lack the strength and coordination to bring down a creature of this size. Something else killed the predator before the sea carried it ashore.

sections.title: Studies in Darnassus
sections.body: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde coordinates efforts in Auberdine to salvage bones and biological samples from Darkshore's stranded sea giants. Night elf researchers in Darnassus hope the remains will show whether illness, disturbances in the deep sea, or arcane corruption drives the giants onto the killing sands.

faq.q: What kind of beast washed up on the shore?
aliases: what animal is dead on the beach
faq.answer: A giant thresher washed ashore, far larger than the threshers usually seen near Darkshore's beaches.

aliases: did murlocs kill the sea creature
faq.answer: No. Murlocs swarm the carcass to feed, but even in large groups they are too weak to hunt a deep-water beast of that size.

faq.q: Why are sea creatures stranding themselves along Darkshore?
faq.answer: The cause is unknown. Night elf researchers suspect ocean disturbances, disease, or ecological distress may drive deep-sea creatures into shallow surf, where they become stranded and die.

aliases: who takes the bones in auberdine
faq.answer: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde is a night elf researcher in Auberdine. She collects bones and biological samples from beached wildlife along Darkshore for study in Darnassus.

faq.q: Where are the collected bones sent?
aliases: what does auberdine do with bones
faq.answer: The collected bones go to scholars and naturalists in Darnassus, where they are examined for anatomical and magical clues.

aliases: where is the beached sea creature
faq.answer: The carcass lies on the sandy shore of Mist's Edge, along Darkshore's western coast.

angles.text: For night elves, the strandings along Darkshore signal trouble in the surrounding waters. Naturalists in Auberdine and Darnassus are investigating before more marine life perishes.
As a druid, you may see the stranded giant as an alarming sign of disturbance in the Veiled Sea's natural balance.
